<?php
class AliasParent137 {
    public $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G|"; return $this->value; }
    }
}
class AliasChild137 extends AliasParent137 {
    public $value = 11;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}

class AliasGrandchild137 extends AliasChild137 {}
echo "A:";
$child = new AliasGrandchild137;
$alias =& $child->value;
echo $alias === 11 ? "alias11|" : "bad-initial|";
$alias = "word";
echo $alias === "word" ? "word|" : "bad-string|";
$copy = $child->value;
$alias = 13;
echo $copy === "word" ? "copy-word|" : "bad-copy|";
echo $child->value === 13 ? "live13|" : "bad-live|";
unset($child);
$alias = "free";
echo $alias === "free" ? "free|" : "bad-free|";
echo $copy === "word" ? "copy-still-word|Z|" : "bad-copy-after|";

<?php
class NullParent137 {
    public $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G|"; return $this->value; }
    }
}
class NullChild137 extends NullParent137 {
    public $value;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}

class NullGrandchild137 extends NullChild137 {}
echo "N:";
$child = new NullGrandchild137;
$alias =& $child->value;
echo $alias === null ? "null|" : "bad-initial|";
$copy = $child->value;
$alias = "set";
echo $copy === null ? "copy-null|" : "bad-copy|";
echo $child->value === "set" ? "live-set|" : "bad-live|";
unset($child);
$alias = "post";
echo $alias === "post" ? "post|Z|" : "bad-post|";

<?php
class BindParent137 {
    public $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G|"; return $this->value; }
    }
}
class BindChild137 extends BindParent137 {
    public $value = 11;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}

class BindGrandchild137 extends BindChild137 {}
echo "R:";
$child = new BindGrandchild137;
$child->value = "own";
$replacement = 17;
try {
    $child->value =& $replacement; // REBIND
    echo "bad-rebind|";
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage() === "Cannot assign by reference to overloaded object" ? "blocked|" : "bad-message|";
    echo $error->getLine() === 18 ? "line|" : "bad-line|";
    echo $error->getFile() === __FILE__ ? "file|" : "bad-file|";
}
echo $child->value === "own" ? "kept-own|" : "bad-property|";
$replacement = 19;
echo $child->value === "own" ? "separate-own|" : "bad-rebound|";
echo $replacement === 19 ? "rhs19|" : "bad-rhs|";
unset($child);
echo "Z|";

<?php
class AliasParent137 {
    public int $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G:", __CLASS__, "/", static::class, "|"; return $this->value; }
    }
}
class AliasChild137 extends AliasParent137 {
    public int $value = 11;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}

class AliasGrandchild137 extends AliasChild137 {}
echo "A:";
$child = new AliasGrandchild137;
$alias =& $child->value;
echo $alias === 11 ? "alias11|" : "bad-initial|";
$alias = "12";
echo $alias === 12 ? "typed12|" : "bad-typed|";
$copy = $child->value;
$alias = 13;
echo $copy === 12 ? "copy12|" : "bad-copy|";
echo $alias === 13 ? "alias13|" : "bad-alias|";
unset($child);
$alias = "free";
echo $alias === "free" ? "free|" : "bad-free|";
echo $copy === 12 ? "copy-still12|Z|" : "bad-copy-after|";
